system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform these two different actions simultaneously: sdrfndrf_verify_otp and sdrfndrf_calculate_relief_amount. For your information, my aadhaar_number is 100020009416, my claim_id is SDRF-CLM-30000001, my otp is dummy_otp_2950.

function.name: sdrfndrf_calculate_relief_amount
function.description: Calculates estimated relief amount based on severity, damage extent, and disaster type. Requires session_token. Assessment must be completed. Does NOT disburse relief. Fails if assessment not completed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: sdrfndrf_verify_otp
function.description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT check disaster status. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.
